LanguageData.VGE_IdeoRole_EngineeringSpecialist.descr: A formal shipboard office entrusted with keeping the Hellion airworthy. The engineering specialist gains construction and repair efficiency and can coordinate the surrounding crew during major maintenance work.
LanguageData.VGE_IdeoRole_Navigator.description: A formal shipboard office responsible for orbital observation and long-range navigation. The navigator studies surviving USSA charts, tracks hazards, and improves the Hellion crew's research efficiency and travel safety.
LanguageData.VGE_IdeoRole_PilotingSpecialist.descript: A formal shipboard office reserved for an expert Hellion pilot. This specialist is trained to handle orbital maneuvers, system failures, and emergency launches that would endanger an ordinary crew.
